children: Bajaj Finance, India’s largest private sector non-banking financial company (NBFC), on Wednesday launched a qualified institutional placement (QIP) to raise up to ₹11,700 crore ($1.25 billion), setting an indicative issue price of ₹1,025 per share, a 5 per cent discount to its last closing price on the National Stock Exchange (NSE). The indicative price is above the Securities and Exchange Board of India’s (SEBI’s) floor price of ₹992.25 per share.

Tata Power on Wednesday appointed Sanjay Banga, currently president of its renewables business, as Chief Executive Officer-designate, with the board approving his elevation as managing director and CEO for a five-year term beginning May 1, 2027, subject to shareholder approval.

Kutch Copper Ltd (KCL), a unit of Adani Enterprises Ltd and operator of one of the world’s largest single-location copper smelters, today announced that it has received the prestigious Veramark Assurance certification, becoming the first Indian producer to be recognised under the global framework for responsible copper production. Veramark Assurance, formerly Copper Mark, is a leading independent assurance framework that promotes responsible practices across the copper, nickel, and zinc value chains. The certification is awarded to facilities that comply with rigorous, independent third-party audits of their environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance.

The Sandur Manganese and Iron Ores Ltd has received environmental clearance from the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEF&CC) to increase the production capacity of its iron ore mine from 7.85 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) to 9.42 MTPA. The clearance also allows the company to reduce its manganese ore production capacity from 1.34 MTPA to 0.733 MTPA at its mining lease (No. 2678), spread across 1,860.10 hectares.

Alivus Life Sciences (formerly Glenmark Life Sciences) is acquiring a 76% majority stake in IQGen-X Pharma Private Limited for an all-cash consideration of ₹9.12 crore (₹91.2 million). On November 11, 2026, Alivus executed a formal Shareholders’ Agreement (SHA) with IQGen-X Pharma and its continuing founders to finalise governance terms ahead of the deal’s targeted closing around December 6.

Drug maker Aurobindo Pharma Ltd has informed the exchanges that the US Food and Drug Administration (US FDA) has classified the inspection of its step-down wholly-owned subsidiary, Lannett Company LLC, as “official action indicated” (OAI), following an inspection at its Seymour facility in Indiana, US, in August 2026. The US FDA conducted the inspection between August 17 and 21, 2026, and issued four observations after its completion. Aurobindo Pharma said it had responded to all four observations within the stipulated time.
